name: panicly
description: Monitor Panicly request traffic and open request audits from Raycast.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Panicly Base URL
preferences.description: The Panicly web app URL to read request data from.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: Panicly API Key
preferences.description: A project API key from Panicly Settings or onboarding.

preferences.name: requestLimit
preferences.title: Request Limit
preferences.description: How many recent requests to load. Panicly caps this at 50.

commands.name: view-requests
commands.title: View Requests
commands.description: Show recent Panicly gateway requests, decisions, and request audit details.
